meta.name: wcag-audit-patterns
meta.description: Conduct WCAG 2.2 accessibility audits with automated testing, manual verification, and remediation guidance. Use when auditing websites for accessibility, fixing WCAG violations, or implementing accessible design patterns.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审计网站无障碍并给出修复建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果网站需要满足 WCAG 无障碍标准且不确定从何入手。
copy.tagline_en: Audit website accessibility and get fix guidance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to make your website accessible to people with disabilities and meet WCAG standards.

howto.what: 它会按 WCAG 2.2 检查网页无障碍问题:做自动化扫描并配合人工核查,把问题按严重程度分级,再给出具体修复建议。
howto.when: 当你要求审计网站无障碍、修复 WCAG 违规,或实现无障碍设计模式时触发。

say.text: 审计这个首页的 WCAG 2.2 无障碍问题,按严重程度分级
say.note: 输出分级问题清单与修复建议

say.text: 这个表单缺哪些标签?给我修复写法
say.note: 指出缺失标签并给出改法

say.text: 检查这个自定义下拉组件能不能只用键盘操作
say.note: 报告键盘可操作性相关问题

howto.what_en: It audits web pages against WCAG 2.2: automated scans plus manual checks, issues ranked by severity, with remediation guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you audit a site for accessibility, fix WCAG violations, or implement accessible design patterns.

say_en.text: Audit this homepage for WCAG 2.2 issues and rank them by severity.
say_en.note: Returns a severity-ranked issue list with fixes.

say_en.text: What labels are missing on this form, and how do I fix them?
say_en.note: Shows missing labels and fix code.

say_en.text: Check whether this custom dropdown works with keyboard only.
